questions.q: In the year 2014, the population of a city was 30,000. The population of the city increased in 2015, 2016, and 2017 by a constant percentage of \(x\%\) every year. In the year 2018, if the population of the city was increased by 20% over the previous year, then the population of the city became 32,208 more than that of the year 2014. What is the value of \(x\)?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change (CI, Area, Successive discounts).

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, 2014 se 2017 tak 3 saal ka same successive growth hai (\(x\%\)). Uske baad 2018 me 20% badha. Seedha reverse gear laga! 2018 ki final value ko 20% kam karke (matlab \(\frac{5}{6}\) se multiply karke) 2017 pe aa ja. Phir Initial (2014) aur Final (2017) ka ratio leke seedha Cube Root pel de. 3 saal ka gap = Cube Root. Khel khatam!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Reverse Ratio & Root Method.

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Final } P_{2018} = 30000 + 32208 = 62208 $$

$$ P_{2017} = 62208 \times \frac{5}{6} = 51840 $$

$$ \text{Multiplier}^3 = \frac{P_{2017}}{P_{2014}} = \frac{51840}{30000} = \frac{5184}{3000} = \frac{1728}{1000} = \frac{216}{125} $$

$$ \text{Multiplier} = \sqrt[3]{\frac{216}{125}} = \frac{6}{5} \implies 20\% \text{ Increase} $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic Compound Interest approach (Tree Builder).

Mathematically :-

$$ 30000 \times \left(1 + \frac{x}{100}\right)^3 \times \left(1 + \frac{20}{100}\right) = 62208 $$

$$ 30000 \times \left(1 + \frac{x}{100}\right)^3 \times \frac{6}{5} = 62208 $$

$$ 36000 \times \left(1 + \frac{x}{100}\right)^3 = 62208 $$

$$ \left(1 + \frac{x}{100}\right)^3 = \frac{62208}{36000} = \frac{1728}{1000} = 1.728 $$

$$ 1 + \frac{x}{100} = 1.2 \implies x = 20 $$

Exam Takeaway: Method 1 (Ninja Technique) sabse best hai. Jab bhi time periods ka gap \(n\) saal ho, toh fractions ka \(n^{th}\) root nikalna sabse fast approach hota hai. Weighted average ya basic formula exam me lamba fasa dega.

StepAction (N years Successive)
Step 1Ratio banao = (Final Value / Initial Value)
Step 2Agar 2 saal ka gap hai -> Square Root
Step 3Agar 3 saal ka gap hai -> Cube Root

questions.q: The population of a village was (3x + 1000). In a year, with the increase in population of males by 9.33% and that of females by 8%, the population of the village became 17400. The number of males increased are (x + 4000), then find the value of x.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: JSM/Deviation

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, mixed variables wala quadratic sawal hai. Isko equation se solve karna self-sabotage hai. Seedha pehla option $5000$ le aur values confirm kar. Round figure values se math ekdum match ho jayega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique): Option testing udao seedha check karo increase amount.

Mathematically :-
$$Let \ x = 5000 \\\\ Initial \ Total = 3(5000) + 1000 = 16000 \\\\ Final \ Total = 17400 \Rightarrow Inc = 1400 \\\\ Males = 5000 + 4000 = 9000, \ Females = 16000 - 9000 = 7000 \\\\ Male \ Inc = 9000 \times \frac{28}{300} = 840 \\\\ Female \ Inc = 7000 \times \frac{8}{100} = 560 \\\\ Total \ Inc = 840 + 560 = 1400 \ (Condition \ Satisfied!)$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Variable x rakh kar proper linear system setup karna.

Mathematically :-
$$M = x + 4000 \\\\ F = (3x + 1000) - (x + 4000) = 2x - 3000 \\\\ Inc = 17400 - (3x + 1000) = 16400 - 3x \\\\ (x + 4000)\times\frac{28}{300} + (2x - 3000)\times\frac{8}{100} = 16400 - 3x \\\\ \text{(Too lengthy, directly yields } x = 5000)$$

Exam Takeaway: Variables dekhte hi Option elimination is the ultimate key. Quadratic solve karne par time waste hota hai.

Option HackingAlway start with round figures (like 5000) for clean calculations.

questions.q: The population of bacteria in a culture prepared in a lab is 8 * 10^8. Their birth and death rates per hour are 12.75% and 10.75% respectively. Find their population in the culture after 3 hours.
questions.s:
Tool Triggered: 2. Successive Change

The "Pen-Free" Observation First:
Dekh bhai, exact calculation mat karna, unit digit aur DS laga! Net increase har ghante $12.75 - 10.75 = 2\%$. Yani har ghante population $102\%$ ho jayegi. 3 ghante baad options me zeroes se pehle wali digit check kar. $8 \times 2 \times 2 \times 2 = 64$. Yani end me 4 aana chahiye zeroes se pehle. Sidha option 2!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique):
Unit digit check and zeroes match.

Mathematically :-
$$ \text{Net Rate} = 12.75\% - 10.75\% = +2\% \\ \text{Final Pop} \propto 8 \times 102 \times 102 \times 102 \\ \text{Unit digit check} = 8 \times 2 \times 2 \times 2 = 64 \implies 4 \\ \text{Zeroes cancel out} \implies \text{ends with } ...6400 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder):
Basic compound growth formula lagao.

Mathematically :-
$$ A = P \left(1 + \frac{r}{100}\right)^n \\ A = 8 \times 10^8 \times \left(\frac{102}{100}\right)^3 \\ A = 800000000 \times 1.02 \times 1.02 \times 1.02 \\ A = 800 \times 1061208 = 848966400 $$

Exam Takeaway: Examiner teri mazdoori nahi, smartness check kar raha hai. Aise options hamesha unit digit se toot'te hain.

questions.q: A mixture of milk and water contains 8 liters of water. On adding 6 liters of milk and 8 liters of water, the amount of milk becomes 75% of the new mixture. Now 10 liters of mixture is removed, then find the quantity of milk in the final mixture.
questions.s:
Tool Triggered: 5. Unitary Scaling

The "Pen-Free" Observation First:
Dekh bhai, Naya water 16L ho gaya. Milk $75\%$ hai toh water $25\%$ bacha, yani ratio 3:1. 1 part 16L hai, toh 3 part milk 48L hoga. Total mix 64L ka ho gaya. Jab 10L nikalenge toh $75\%$ (yani 7.5L) milk niklega. 48 me se 7.5 hata, bacha 40.5L. Bina pen uthaye attack!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique):
Direct ratio mapping on new mixture.

Mathematically :-
$$ \text{New Water} = 8 + 8 = 16 \text{ L} \\ \text{Milk : Water} = 75\% : 25\% = 3 : 1 \\ 1 \text{ unit} \rightarrow 16 \text{ L} \implies 3 \text{ units (Milk)} \rightarrow 48 \text{ L} \\ \text{Milk removed} = 10 \times \frac{3}{4} = 7.5 \text{ L} \\ \text{Remaining Milk} = 48 - 7.5 = 40.5 \text{ L} $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder):
Initial variable maankar equation set karna.

Mathematically :-
$$ \text{Initial Milk} = M, \quad \text{Water} = 8 \\ \frac{M + 6}{8 + 8} = \frac{75}{25} = \frac{3}{1} \\ M + 6 = 16 \times 3 = 48 \implies M = 42 \text{ L} \\ \text{Total New Mix} = 48 + 16 = 64 \text{ L} \\ \text{Milk in 10L removed} = \frac{48}{64} \times 10 = 7.5 \text{ L} \\ \text{Final Milk} = 48 - 7.5 = 40.5 \text{ L} $$

Exam Takeaway: Hamesha naye mixture ke final ratio par focus kar. Purani values nikalne ki zarurat hi nahi agar direct naya mix mil raha hai.

questions.q: A scholarship fund of Rs. 1200 is to be distributed between two students, A and B, in a ratio 5:3. However, after allocating 200 to administrative charges, the remaining amount is first increased by 10% as a bonus before the final division. What amount will student A receive? (PHASE XIII(HS) - 24/07/2025 - SHIFT 2)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, amount me se directly deduction aur bonus calculate karke final pool alag kar. Us pool ka $\frac{5}{8}$ seedha A ka hissa banega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Final pool ko direct fraction multiplier ke sath jod de. Mathematically :-

$\text{Pool} = (1200 - 200) \times 1.10 = 1100$

$A_{share} = 1100 \times \frac{5}{8}$

$A_{share} = 1100 \times 0.625 = 687.5$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Har step alag solve kar aur unit value nikal kar multiply kar. Mathematically :-

$\text{Rem} = 1200 - 200 = 1000$

$\text{Final} = 1000 + 10\% = 1100$

$\text{Total parts} = 5+3 = 8 \Rightarrow 8 \text{ parts } = 1100$

$1 \text{ part } = 137.5$

$A = 5 \times 137.5 = 687.5$

Exam Takeaway: Ratio ke final value ko parts me todne se behtar seedha multiplier se fraction multiply kar diya kar.

questions.q: A, B and C spend $75\%$, $80\%$ and $90\%$ of their incomes, respectively. If their savings are in the ratio 4: 6: 5 and the difference between the incomes of A and C is 25,500, then the income of B is?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, expenditure percentage diya hai par ratio savings ka diya hai. Ulta sochna padega. Incomes nikalne ke liye savings ko uske percentage se bhag (divide) de. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Pehle saving percentage nikal: A=$25\%$, B=$20\%$, C=$10\%$. Ab direct Income ratio likh = $\frac{\text{Saving Ratio}}{\text{Saving } \%}$. Yani $\frac{4}{25} : \frac{6}{20} : \frac{5}{10}$. Percentage hata de kyunki ratio me common cut jayega. Bacha $\frac{4}{25} : \frac{6}{20} : \frac{5}{10} \implies \frac{16}{100} : \frac{30}{100} : \frac{50}{100}$. Base 100 cut gaya, naya ratio $16:30:50$ yaani $8:15:25$ aagaya. A aur C ka difference $25 - 8 = 17$ unit hai. Sawal kehta hai ye $25500$ hai. $1$ unit = $1500$. B ki income puchi hai ($15$ unit), toh $15 \times 1500 = 22500$ answer hoga! Bawal cheez hai ye ratio base shifting. Method 2 (Concept Builder): A ki income ka $25\% = 4x \implies A = 16x$. B ki income ka $20\% = 6x \implies B = 30x$. C ki income ka $10\% = 5x \implies C = 50x$. Income ratio $16x : 30x : 50x = 8 : 15 : 25$. Diff $25 - 8 = 17$ unit $= 25500$. $1$ unit $= 1500$. $B = 15 \times 1500 = 22500$. Exam Takeaway: Expenditure diya ho aur saving ratio pooche to turant $100 - x$ karke equate kar liya kar.
PersonIncome Ratio
A$4 / 25\% = 16$
B$6 / 20\% = 30$
C$5 / 10\% = 50$

questions.q: Identical protein powder scoops are sold in jars of two sizes, small and large. The large jar is sold for twice the price of the small jar. If the selling price per gram of protein in the large jar is $12 \%$ less than that in the small jar, then the percentage by which the weight of protein in the large jar exceeds that in the small jar is nearest to:
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Cross-Product

Pen-Free Observation: Price double hua aur rate $12 \%$ kam yani $100$ se $88$. Seedha fractional ratio lagao bina kisi 100 ya x ke. Weight ka ratio $Price/Rate$ hota hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique): Fractional ratios se comparison karo. Values likho aur cross divide karo.

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Price Ratio (Small : Large)} = 1 : 2 \\ \text{Rate Ratio (Small : Large)} = 100 : 88 = 25 : 22 \\ \text{Weight Ratio} = \frac{\text{Price}}{\text{Rate}} \\ W_S : W_L = \frac{1}{25} : \frac{2}{22} \\ W_S : W_L = \frac{1}{25} : \frac{1}{11} = 11 : 25 \\ \text{Increase} = 25 - 11 = 14 \\ \% \text{ Increase} = \frac{14}{11} \times 100 = 127.27 \% $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic formula likh kar variables P aur w me ratio banao.

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Let Small Jar Price} = P, \text{ Weight} = w \\ \text{Large Jar Price} = 2P, \text{ Weight} = W \\ \text{Small Rate} = \frac{P}{w}, \text{ Large Rate} = \frac{2P}{W} \\ \frac{2P}{W} = 0.88 \times \frac{P}{w} \\ \frac{W}{w} = \frac{2}{0.88} = \frac{200}{88} = \frac{25}{11} \\ \% \text{ Increase} = \frac{25-11}{11} \times 100 = 127.27 \% $$

Exam Takeaway: Jab bhi teen dependent variables (Price = Rate $\times$ Weight) hon, hamesha initial aur final ka ratio fraction me divide kar liya karo.

questions.q: If m% of m + n% of n = $2\%$ of (m x n), then what percentage of m is n?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, sawal me equation ghoor ke dekh, $m^2 + n^2 - 2mn = 0$ chupa hua hai isme, pure algebra ka khel hai!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Percentage ko denominator me daal: $\frac{m^2}{100} + \frac{n^2}{100} = \frac{2mn}{100}$. $100$ ko sab jagah se kaat de. Bacha $m^2 + n^2 - 2mn = 0$. Ye kya hota hai? $(m-n)^2 = 0$. Matlab $m = n$ ho gaya. Agar dono barabar hain toh 'n', 'm' ka pura $100\%$ hoga. Free ke 2 marks the ye!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Values rakh ke dekh le. Agar m = 10, n = 10 maane. Toh $10\%$ of $10 + 10\%$ of $10 = 1 + 1 = 2$. Aur RHS me $2\%$ of $100 = 2$. Match kar gaya. Toh 10, 10 ka kitna percent hai? $100\%$.

Exam Takeaway: Arithmetic me algebra ghusa ke darane ki koshish hamesha fail hoti hai agar basics strong hon.

Algebra FormIdentity
A. Expanded1. $m^2 + n^2 - 2mn = 0$
B. Contracted2. $(m-n)^2 = 0 \implies m=n$

questions.q: Two saleswomen, Kavitha and Kalyani, are allowed 12\% and 15\% commission, respectively on the total sales made by them. Kavitha gets 3\% and Kalyani gets 5\% extra bonus on the sales over Rs. 20,000. If the difference in total earning of both Kavitha and Kalyani is Rs. 7,600, then Kavitha's total earning is:
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 3. JSM (Junior Satisfaction Method) / Deviation & 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, jab sales par commission aur bonus alag-alag ho, toh base shift karke ya total sales ko ek single variable mein merge karke equation banane se mamla 10-15 seconds me sulajh jata hai.

Method 1 (Basic Split - Sales $> 20,000 = x$):
Total Sales = $20,000 + x$.
Kalyani's Total = $15\% \times 20,000 + 20\% \times x$
Kavitha's Total = $12\% \times 20,000 + 15\% \times x$
Difference = $3\% \times 20,000 + 5\% \times x = 7600 \implies 600 + 5\% x = 7600 \implies 5\% x = 7000 \implies x = 1,40,000$.
Kavitha's Earning = $12\% \times 20,000 + 15\% \times 1,40,000 = 2400 + 21000 = \mathbf{23,400}$.

Method 2 (Image 2 - The Split Method):
First 20k par Kalyani leads by $(15\% - 12\%) = 3\% \implies 600$ Rs.
Total difference 7600 hai, toh remaining diff = $7600 - 600 = 7000$ Rs.
On remaining sales ($x$), Kalyani leads by $(20\% - 15\%) = 5\%$.
$5\% = 7000 \implies 100\% = 1,40,000$ (Remaining Sales).
Kavitha's Earning = $(12\% \times 20,000) + (15\% \times 1,40,000) = \mathbf{23,400}$.

Method 3 (Image 2 - The Pro 'Shifted Base' Method):
Maan le bonus first 20k par bhi milta (Fake base)!
Kalyani gets extra $5\% \times 20,000 = +1000$.
Kavitha gets extra $3\% \times 20,000 = +600$.
Naya Difference = $7600 + 1000 - 600 = 8000$.
Ab flat percentage par difference = $20\% - 15\% = 5\%$.
$5\% = 8000 \implies \text{Total Sales} = 1,60,000$.
Kavitha's Real Earning = $(15\% \times 1,60,000) - (\text{Fake } 600) = 24000 - 600 = \mathbf{23,400}$.

Method 4 (Total Sales = $x$ / Single Merged Equation):
Total Sales = $x$. Bonus milega $(x - 20,000)$ par.
Kalyani = $15\% x + 5\%(x - 20000) = 20\% x - 1000$.
Kavitha = $12\% x + 3\%(x - 20000) = 15\% x - 600$.
Difference = $(20\% x - 1000) - (15\% x - 600) = 7600 \implies 5\% x - 400 = 7600 \implies 5\% x = 8000 \implies x = 1,60,000$.
Kavitha = $15\% \times 1,60,000 - 600 = 24000 - 600 = \mathbf{23,400}$.

Exam Takeaway: Expressions ko hamesha expand kar ke $x$ (variable) ko ek single percentage block me merge kar liya kar, ya Method 3 (Shifted base) laga ke pen-free nikal liya kar!

questions.q: A traveler loses $20 \frac{1}{2} \%$ of his total money and after spending $80 \%$ of the remainder, he is left with Rs. 159. How much money did he have at the start?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change

Pen-Free Observation: $20.5 \%$ toh gaya, bacha seedha $79.5 \%$. Ab us remaining ka $80 \%$ kharch ho gaya matlab bacha sirf $20 \%$. Seedha $79.5 \%$ ka $20 \%$ nikalna hai (yani $1/5$-th) jo exactly $15.9 \%$ baithta hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique): Seedha final percentage bacha kar value se compare kar.

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Remaining after loss} = 100 \% - 20.5 \% = 79.5 \% \\ \text{Left after spending } 80 \% = 20 \% \text{ of Remaining} \\ \text{Final Left} = 20 \% \text{ of } 79.5 \% = \frac{1}{5} \times 79.5 \% = 15.9 \% \\ 15.9 \% = 159 \\ 1 \% = 10 \implies 100 \% = 1000 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Fractional chain equation setup karo base P maan ke.

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Let total money} = P \\ P \times (1 - 0.205) \times (1 - 0.8) = 159 \\ P \times 0.795 \times 0.2 = 159 \\ P \times 0.159 = 159 \\ P = \frac{159}{0.159} = 1000 $$

Exam Takeaway: $20 \frac{1}{2} \%$ dekh ke hamesha mixed fraction me open karne ki need nahi padti, decimals ($20.5 \%$) kabhi kabhi exactly setup hote hain ki directly multiply ho jaye.

TimelineValue Remaining
After Loss$79.5 \%$
After Spending$15.9 \%$

questions.q: The price of fuel decreases by 55%, 55%, and 55% in three successive months, but increases by 65% in the fourth month. What is the percentage increase/decrease (rounded off to two decimal places) in the price of fuel in the fourth month, as compared to its original price?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Lagatar 3 baar 55% girne se value zameen par aa jayegi. Uspe chotu sa 65% ka increment ghanta fark nahi daalega. Answer bhayankar decrease (around 85%) hi aayega. Isme ratio method calc hoga bahut zyada and ganda wala so approx leke chalo. so always prefer this method for large changes

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai, formula wagaira sab bhool ja, seedha decimals multiplier laga. 55% gira yani $0.45$ bacha.
Net multiplier = $0.45 \times 0.45 \times 0.45 \times 1.65$.
$$0.091125 \times 1.65 \approx 0.1503$$
Yani original value ka lagbhag $15.04\%$ hi bacha hai. Toh decrease kitna hua? $100 - 15.04 = 84.96\%$.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Yahan $X + Y + \frac{XY}{100}$ wala formula lagana apne pairo par kulhadi maarne jaisa hai. Chain reaction decimals me chalana hi padega.

Exam Takeaway: TCS ke successive traps me decimals ko lagbhag 2 places tak approximate karke seedha multiply kar.

questions.q: The lengths of two adjacent sides of a square are increased by $35\%$ and $25\%$ respectively. As a result the area of the rectangle will be more than the area of the square by?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, 2D figure ka area $L \times B$ hota hai. Dono badh rahe hain, toh net successive percentage seedha hit karna hai formula se.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Aankh band karke $A + B + \frac{AB}{100}$ thok de. $35 + 25 + (35 \times 25)/100 = 60 + 8.75 = 68.75\%$. Options me last digit pehchano, pen mat uthana aisi calculations ke liye!

Mathematically :-
$\% = 35 + 25 + \frac{35 \times 25}{100}$
$\% = 60 + 8.75 = 68.75\%$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Square ki side 100 maan, area 10000. Nayi side 135 aur 125. Multiply kar aur difference dekh kar 100 se divide. Kyu karna itna dukh?

Mathematically :-
$A_{old} = 100 \times 100 = 10000$
$A_{new} = 135 \times 125 = 16875$
$\% = \frac{6875}{10000} \times 100 = 68.75\%$

Exam Takeaway: Area change hamesha $X+Y+XY/100$ format follow karta hai, time and mind space dono save karo.

questions.q: Income of a person increases by $x\%$ and $x/2\%$ during first and third year but decreases by $x\%$ and $x/2\%$ 2nd year and 4th year respectively if the total decrement during four year is $\text{Rs. } 3340.8$. then find the initial income of person if during first two-year, total salary decreases by $36\%$
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, thoda heavy question hai, tukdo me padh! Ek baar plus, ek baar same percent minus ho, toh result humesha net decrease hota hai $\frac{x^2}{100}\%$. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Pehle do saal: $+x\%$ aur $-x\%$. Net change = $- \frac{x^2}{100}\%$. Ye value $36\%$ decrease ke barabar di hai. Toh $\frac{x^2}{100} = 36 \implies x = 60$. Teesra aur chautha saal padh: $x/2 = 30\%$ se badha aur fir $30\%$ ghata. Iska net decrease hoga $- \frac{30^2}{100} = -9\%$. Charo saal ka overall successive nikal: Pehle cycle me value $0.64$ times bachi (36% gayi), dusre me $0.91$ times (9% gayi). Overall bachi $= 0.64 \times 0.91 = 0.5824$. Decrease kitna hua? $1 - 0.5824 = 0.4176$ (yani $41.76\%$). $41.76\%$ of Initial Salary = $3340.8$. Solve karega toh Base = $3340.8 / 0.4176 = 8000$ aayega. Method 2 (Concept Builder): Fraction se ratio banayega tab bhi aayega par 0.64 aur 0.91 ke decimals zyada clean approach dete hain yahan. Exam Takeaway: Symmetrical successive changes ($+x\%, -x\%$) humesha negative impact daalte hain. Is property pe direct hit kar.

Years 3-4$+30\%, -30\%$$0.91$ ($-9\%$)

questions.q: In an election between P, R and S, $\frac{1}{10}$ of the total votes polled are invalid. Votes polled in favour of R and S are half of the total votes polled, and they get equal votes. Due to a fault in the machine, half of the votes of S and half of the invalid votes are counted additionally in favour of R. What is the overall percentage of votes secured by R due to the fault?
questions.s:
**Core Conceptual Tool:** 5. Unitary Scaling

**Pen-Free Observation:** Dekh bhai aise karna hai... Total votes base ko 100 maan, kyuki distribution fractions aur 'half' me diye hain, decimals nahi ayenge aur direct percent nikal jayega overall 100 par.

**Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach):** Total votes = 100. Invalid hue 10. Valid bache 90. R aur S ka total milakar half hai (yani 50), aur equal baant lo toh R=25, S=25. Ab machine fault dekhte hain: S ke aadhe votes (12.5) aur Invalid ke aadhe (5) seedha R ki jholi me aagaye. R ko total kitne mile? $25 (original) + 12.5 + 5 = 42.5$. Total votes 100 the, toh percentage seedha 42.5\% ban gaya.

**Method 2 (Concept Builder):** Logical branching bana le. Total = P+R+S+Invalid. Hamein bas R se matlab tha, P ki value nikalne ki zarurat hi nahi padhi (P = valid me bacha 90 - 50 = 40 hoga). Faltu variables me dimag nahi daudana.

**Exam Takeaway:** "Overall percentage" poocha gaya hai isliye base Valid (90) nahi, balki Polled (100) hi rahega. Language trap se bachna.

questions.q: In an examination, the maximum possible score is N while the pass mark is $45\%$ of N. A candidate obtains 36 marks, but falls short of the pass mark by $68\%$. Which one of the following is then correct?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, CDS style ka ghumane wala sawal hai! 'Falls short by $68\%$' padhte hi samajh jaa ki usne total passing marks ka bacha hua percentage hi score kiya hai. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Pass mark apne aap me $100\%$ benchmark hai. Agar koi $68\%$ se piche reh gaya, toh usne laya kitna? Sirf $100\% - 68\% = 32\%$ of passing marks! Ab $32\% = 36$ marks hai. Toh passing marks hue $\frac{36}{32} \times 100 = 112.5$. Question keh raha hai Pass marks N ka $45\%$ hai. Toh $0.45N = 112.5 \implies N = \frac{11250}{45} = 250$. Ab option check kar, 250 kahan fit hota hai? Option D ($243 < N < 252$) me perfectly lie karta hai! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Lamba likhna hai toh likh: Pass = $P$. Score = $P - 0.68P = 0.32P$. Given $0.32P = 36 \implies P = 112.5$. Fir $P = 0.45N \implies 112.5 = 0.45N \implies N = 250$. Concept wahi hai bas variable badle hain. Exam Takeaway: 'Falls short by X\%' ka direct matlab hai usne $(100-X)\%$ score kiya hai benchmark ka. Hamesha remaining percentage pe khela kar!

questions.q: A company allowed $16\%$ commission on the total sales made by salesman and a bonus of $6\%$ on the sales over 7000. If the salesman deposited $\text{Rs. } 8610$ in the company after deducting his earning from the total sales made by him. Find total sales?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: JSM/Deviation.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, imaginary commission method se salesman ko starting ke 7000 par bhi $6\%$ bonus de de, toh overall uniform $22\%$ commission ban jayega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Shift method. Mathematically :-
$$Extra\_Bonus = 6\% \text{ of } 7000 = 420$$
$$New\_Deposit = 8610 - 420 = 8190$$
$$78\% = 8190$$
$$100\% = 10500$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic algebra. Mathematically :-
$$S = \text{Total Sales}$$
$$S - [0.16S + 0.06(S - 7000)] = 8610$$
$$S - 0.22S + 420 = 8610$$
$$0.78S = 8190 \Rightarrow S = 10500$$

If A is the population in 2016 and B is the population in 2020, both are approximated to the next possible integers, then the value of B - A is:

Final Answer: 11680

Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (CI, Area, Successive discounts).

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai, 6\% ka 2 saal mein successive increment 12.36\% hoga. Bridging steps aur intermediate variables hata. A, 50k se chhota hai toh uska increment bhi 50k ke increment (6180) se chhota hoga. Total difference seedha upper bound limit ke sum se chhota aayega.

B - A < 2 \times (12.36\% \times 50000) \\ B - A < 12360 \implies \text{Option D (11680)}

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Standard fractional processing applied. 12.36\% ko lagbhag 12.5\% (\frac{1}{8}) maan kar base ratios shift kar de.

A : 2018 : B = 64 : 72 : 81 \\ B - A = \frac{50000}{72} \times 17 \approx 11805 \implies \text{Option D (11680)}

questions.q: The profits of three partners in a business are initially in the ratio 2 : 3 : 4. If their respective profits are increased by $50\%$, $40\%$, and $30\%$ respectively, what is the new simplified ratio of their profits?
questions.s:
The "Pen-Free" Observation First:

Dekh bhai, ratios ko sidha multipliers se multiply kar. $2 \times 1.5 = 3$. $3 \times 1.4 = 4.2$. $4 \times 1.3 = 5.2$. Ratio bana $3 : 4.2 : 5.2$. Isko 10 se multiply kar de decimal hatane ke liye: $30 : 42 : 52$. Ab isko 2 se kaat de answer saamne hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique):

Mathematically :-

$$ P_1 : P_2 : P_3 = 2 \times 1.5 : 3 \times 1.4 : 4 \times 1.3 \\ = 3 : 4.2 : 5.2 \\ = 30 : 42 : 52 \\ = 15 : 21 : 26 $$

Exam Takeaway: SSC tumhara basics check karta hai ki ratio ko mentally scale karna aata hai ya nahi. 100 maan ke time waste mat karo.

questions.q: The value of a crypto portfolio increases by $37.5\%$ in week 1, then drops by 21,000 dollars in week 2, and again surges by $14 \frac{2}{7}\%$ in week 3. If the final value is exactly $50\%$ more than the initial invested amount, find the initial investment.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling & Reverse Gear.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, yahan percentages hain $37.5\%$ (yaani $3/8$), $14 \frac{2}{7}\%$ (yaani $1/7$) aur $50\%$ (yaani $1/2$). Seedha denominators 8 aur 7 ka LCM 56 pakad aur isko apna base unit man le. Ek absolute drop (21,000 dollars) diya hai, bas usi gap ko units me pakadna hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique): Unitary Reverse Gear.

Mathematically :-

$$Initial = 56u \\ Final = 56u + 50\% = 84u \\ W1_{end} (Forward) = 56u \times \frac{11}{8} = 77u \\ W2_{end} (Backward) = 84u \times \frac{7}{8} = 73.5u \\ Gap (Drop) = 77u - 73.5u = 3.5u \\ 3.5u = 21000 \\ 1u = 6000 \\ Initial (56u) = 56 \times 6000 = 336000$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Variable Reverse Gear.

Mathematically :-

$$Initial = P \\ Final = \frac{3P}{2} \\ W1_{end} = P \times \frac{11}{8} = \frac{11P}{8} \\ W2_{end} (Reverse \ from \ Final) = \frac{3P}{2} \times \frac{7}{8} = \frac{21P}{16} \\ W1_{end} - W2_{end} = 21000 \\ \frac{11P}{8} - \frac{21P}{16} = 21000 \\ \frac{22P - 21P}{16} = 21000 \\ \frac{P}{16} = 21000 \\ P = 336000$$

Exam Takeaway: Jab bhi chain percentage me ek absolute number intermediate step me aa jaye, LCM unit man kar aage aur piche dono taraf se attack kar. Jo gap aayega wahi tera absolute number hoga. Calculation error ka chance zero!

questions.q: In an examination, A got 25% marks more than B, B got 10% less than C and C got 25% more than D. If D got 320 marks out of 500, then the marks obtained by A were?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, jab bhi sequential ya chain mein percentage change ho (A se B, B se C, C se D), toh beech ke variables alag se nikalne ki zaroorat nahi hai. Sidha unka fraction ratio likh kar multiply maar de, B aur C apne aap cancel out ho jayenge aur direct First (A) aur Last (D) ka ratio bachega. Image me jo tune kiya hai, wahi exact ninja technique hai!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Ratio method lagakar sidha multiply kar de (teri image wali method). Mathematically :-

$$ \frac{A}{B} \times \frac{B}{C} \times \frac{C}{D} = \frac{A}{D} $$

$$ \frac{5}{4} \times \frac{9}{10} \times \frac{5}{4} = \frac{45}{32} $$

$$ \text{Here, } \frac{A}{D} = \frac{45}{32} $$

$$ 32 \text{ units } \rightarrow 320 $$

$$ 45 \text{ units } \rightarrow 450 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Peechhe se pakad aur individually backward chain solve kar (jab intermediate values nikalni pad jayein). Mathematically :-

$$ C = 320 + (320 \times \frac{1}{4}) = 400 $$

$$ B = 400 - (400 \times \frac{1}{10}) = 360 $$

$$ A = 360 + (360 \times \frac{1}{4}) = 450 $$

Exam Takeaway: Chain questions mein agar bas First (A) aur Last (D) ka aapas mein relation nikalna ho, toh unke Multiplier Fractions ko direct aapas mein multiply karna sabse fast approach hota hai.

questions.q: A fruit seller sells $45\%$ of the oranges that he has along with one more orange to a customer. He then sells $20\%$ of the remaining oranges and 2 more oranges to a second customer. He then sells $90\%$ of the now remaining oranges to a third customer and is still left with 5 oranges. How many oranges did the fruit seller have initially?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, jab bhi successive remainder wala sawal ho aur numbers me kuch extra joda/ghataya jaye, wahan aage se equations banana suicide hai. Hamesha Reverse Line Method (Peeche se aage ki taraf) use kar. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): C3 (Customer 3) ko $90\%$ becha aur fir bhi 5 bache hain. Yani jo $10\%$ bacha uski value 5 hai. Toh C3 ke aane se theek pehle total $50$ oranges the. C2 ke time: usne $20\%$ beche aur 2 extra diye. Agar wo 2 extra nahi diye hote, toh uske paas $50+2=52$ hote. Ye 52, us stage ka $80\%$ bacha hua hissa tha. Toh C2 ke aane se pehle total = $\frac{52}{0.8} = 65$ the. C1 ke time: usne $45\%$ beche aur 1 extra diya. Agar 1 extra nahi diya hota, toh $65+1=66$ bachte, jo initial ka $55\%$ hote (kyunki $45\%$ bik gaya tha). Toh Initial Total = $\frac{66}{0.55} = 120$. Piche se socho, mind me ho jayega. Method 2 (Concept Builder): Options se uthakar forward track kar sakte ho agar reverse samajh nahi aa raha, jaise 120 ka 45% + 1 nikalna, fir jo bache uspe game khelna. Exam Takeaway: Remaining items aur constant adjustments wale sawal hamesha reverse engineering mangte hain.

questions_hin.q_hi: In the year 2014, the population of a city was 30,000. The population of the city increased in 2015, 2016, and 2017 by a constant percentage of \(x\%\) every year. In the year 2018, if the population of the city was increased by 20% over the previous year, then the population of the city became 32,208 more than that of the year 2014. What is the value of \(x\)?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change (CI, Area, Successive discounts).

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, 2014 se 2017 tak 3 saal ka same successive growth hai (\(x\%\)). Uske baad 2018 me 20% badha. Seedha reverse gear laga! 2018 ki final value ko 20% kam karke (matlab \(\frac{5}{6}\) se multiply karke) 2017 pe aa ja. Phir Initial (2014) aur Final (2017) ka ratio leke seedha Cube Root pel de. 3 saal ka gap = Cube Root. Khel khatam!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Reverse Ratio & Root Method.

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Final } P_{2018} = 30000 + 32208 = 62208 $$

$$ P_{2017} = 62208 \times \frac{5}{6} = 51840 $$

$$ \text{Multiplier}^3 = \frac{P_{2017}}{P_{2014}} = \frac{51840}{30000} = \frac{5184}{3000} = \frac{1728}{1000} = \frac{216}{125} $$

$$ \text{Multiplier} = \sqrt[3]{\frac{216}{125}} = \frac{6}{5} \implies 20\% \text{ Increase} $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic Compound Interest approach (Tree Builder).

Mathematically :-

$$ 30000 \times \left(1 + \frac{x}{100}\right)^3 \times \left(1 + \frac{20}{100}\right) = 62208 $$

$$ 30000 \times \left(1 + \frac{x}{100}\right)^3 \times \frac{6}{5} = 62208 $$

$$ 36000 \times \left(1 + \frac{x}{100}\right)^3 = 62208 $$

$$ \left(1 + \frac{x}{100}\right)^3 = \frac{62208}{36000} = \frac{1728}{1000} = 1.728 $$

$$ 1 + \frac{x}{100} = 1.2 \implies x = 20 $$

Exam Takeaway: Method 1 (Ninja Technique) sabse best hai. Jab bhi time periods ka gap \(n\) saal ho, toh fractions ka \(n^{th}\) root nikalna sabse fast approach hota hai. Weighted average ya basic formula exam me lamba fasa dega.

StepAction (N years Successive)
Step 1Ratio banao = (Final Value / Initial Value)
Step 2Agar 2 saal ka gap hai -> Square Root
Step 3Agar 3 saal ka gap hai -> Cube Root

questions_hin.q_hi: The population of a village was (3x + 1000). In a year, with the increase in population of males by 9.33% and that of females by 8%, the population of the village became 17400. The number of males increased are (x + 4000), then find the value of x.
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: JSM/Deviation

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, mixed variables wala quadratic sawal hai. Isko equation se solve karna self-sabotage hai. Seedha pehla option $5000$ le aur values confirm kar. Round figure values se math ekdum match ho jayega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique): Option testing udao seedha check karo increase amount.

Mathematically :-
$$Let \ x = 5000 \\\\ Initial \ Total = 3(5000) + 1000 = 16000 \\\\ Final \ Total = 17400 \Rightarrow Inc = 1400 \\\\ Males = 5000 + 4000 = 9000, \ Females = 16000 - 9000 = 7000 \\\\ Male \ Inc = 9000 \times \frac{28}{300} = 840 \\\\ Female \ Inc = 7000 \times \frac{8}{100} = 560 \\\\ Total \ Inc = 840 + 560 = 1400 \ (Condition \ Satisfied!)$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Variable x rakh kar proper linear system setup karna.

Mathematically :-
$$M = x + 4000 \\\\ F = (3x + 1000) - (x + 4000) = 2x - 3000 \\\\ Inc = 17400 - (3x + 1000) = 16400 - 3x \\\\ (x + 4000)\times\frac{28}{300} + (2x - 3000)\times\frac{8}{100} = 16400 - 3x \\\\ \text{(Too lengthy, directly yields } x = 5000)$$

Exam Takeaway: Variables dekhte hi Option elimination is the ultimate key. Quadratic solve karne par time waste hota hai.

List IList II
Option HackingAlway start with round figures (like 5000) for clean calculations.

questions_hin.q_hi: The population of bacteria in a culture prepared in a lab is 8 * 10^8. Their birth and death rates per hour are 12.75% and 10.75% respectively. Find their population in the culture after 3 hours.
questions_hin.s_hi:
Tool Triggered: 2. Successive Change

The "Pen-Free" Observation First:
Dekh bhai, exact calculation mat karna, unit digit aur DS laga! Net increase har ghante $12.75 - 10.75 = 2\%$. Yani har ghante population $102\%$ ho jayegi. 3 ghante baad options me zeroes se pehle wali digit check kar. $8 \times 2 \times 2 \times 2 = 64$. Yani end me 4 aana chahiye zeroes se pehle. Sidha option 2!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique):
Unit digit check and zeroes match.

Mathematically :-
$$ \text{Net Rate} = 12.75\% - 10.75\% = +2\% \\ \text{Final Pop} \propto 8 \times 102 \times 102 \times 102 \\ \text{Unit digit check} = 8 \times 2 \times 2 \times 2 = 64 \implies 4 \\ \text{Zeroes cancel out} \implies \text{ends with } ...6400 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder):
Basic compound growth formula lagao.

Mathematically :-
$$ A = P \left(1 + \frac{r}{100}\right)^n \\ A = 8 \times 10^8 \times \left(\frac{102}{100}\right)^3 \\ A = 800000000 \times 1.02 \times 1.02 \times 1.02 \\ A = 800 \times 1061208 = 848966400 $$

Exam Takeaway: Examiner teri mazdoori nahi, smartness check kar raha hai. Aise options hamesha unit digit se toot'te hain.

questions_hin.q_hi: A mixture of milk and water contains 8 liters of water. On adding 6 liters of milk and 8 liters of water, the amount of milk becomes 75% of the new mixture. Now 10 liters of mixture is removed, then find the quantity of milk in the final mixture.
questions_hin.s_hi:
Tool Triggered: 5. Unitary Scaling

The "Pen-Free" Observation First:
Dekh bhai, Naya water 16L ho gaya. Milk $75\%$ hai toh water $25\%$ bacha, yani ratio 3:1. 1 part 16L hai, toh 3 part milk 48L hoga. Total mix 64L ka ho gaya. Jab 10L nikalenge toh $75\%$ (yani 7.5L) milk niklega. 48 me se 7.5 hata, bacha 40.5L. Bina pen uthaye attack!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique):
Direct ratio mapping on new mixture.

Mathematically :-
$$ \text{New Water} = 8 + 8 = 16 \text{ L} \\ \text{Milk : Water} = 75\% : 25\% = 3 : 1 \\ 1 \text{ unit} \rightarrow 16 \text{ L} \implies 3 \text{ units (Milk)} \rightarrow 48 \text{ L} \\ \text{Milk removed} = 10 \times \frac{3}{4} = 7.5 \text{ L} \\ \text{Remaining Milk} = 48 - 7.5 = 40.5 \text{ L} $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder):
Initial variable maankar equation set karna.

Mathematically :-
$$ \text{Initial Milk} = M, \quad \text{Water} = 8 \\ \frac{M + 6}{8 + 8} = \frac{75}{25} = \frac{3}{1} \\ M + 6 = 16 \times 3 = 48 \implies M = 42 \text{ L} \\ \text{Total New Mix} = 48 + 16 = 64 \text{ L} \\ \text{Milk in 10L removed} = \frac{48}{64} \times 10 = 7.5 \text{ L} \\ \text{Final Milk} = 48 - 7.5 = 40.5 \text{ L} $$

Exam Takeaway: Hamesha naye mixture ke final ratio par focus kar. Purani values nikalne ki zarurat hi nahi agar direct naya mix mil raha hai.

questions_hin.q_hi: A scholarship fund of Rs. 1200 is to be distributed between two students, A and B, in a ratio 5:3. However, after allocating 200 to administrative charges, the remaining amount is first increased by 10% as a bonus before the final division. What amount will student A receive? (PHASE XIII(HS) - 24/07/2025 - SHIFT 2)
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, amount me se directly deduction aur bonus calculate karke final pool alag kar. Us pool ka $\frac{5}{8}$ seedha A ka hissa banega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Final pool ko direct fraction multiplier ke sath jod de. Mathematically :-

$\text{Pool} = (1200 - 200) \times 1.10 = 1100$

$A_{share} = 1100 \times \frac{5}{8}$

$A_{share} = 1100 \times 0.625 = 687.5$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Har step alag solve kar aur unit value nikal kar multiply kar. Mathematically :-

$\text{Rem} = 1200 - 200 = 1000$

$\text{Final} = 1000 + 10\% = 1100$

$\text{Total parts} = 5+3 = 8 \Rightarrow 8 \text{ parts } = 1100$

$1 \text{ part } = 137.5$

$A = 5 \times 137.5 = 687.5$

Exam Takeaway: Ratio ke final value ko parts me todne se behtar seedha multiplier se fraction multiply kar diya kar.

questions_hin.q_hi: A, B and C spend $75\%$, $80\%$ and $90\%$ of their incomes, respectively. If their savings are in the ratio 4: 6: 5 and the difference between the incomes of A and C is 25,500, then the income of B is?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, expenditure percentage diya hai par ratio savings ka diya hai. Ulta sochna padega. Incomes nikalne ke liye savings ko uske percentage se bhag (divide) de. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Pehle saving percentage nikal: A=$25\%$, B=$20\%$, C=$10\%$. Ab direct Income ratio likh = $\frac{\text{Saving Ratio}}{\text{Saving } \%}$. Yani $\frac{4}{25} : \frac{6}{20} : \frac{5}{10}$. Percentage hata de kyunki ratio me common cut jayega. Bacha $\frac{4}{25} : \frac{6}{20} : \frac{5}{10} \implies \frac{16}{100} : \frac{30}{100} : \frac{50}{100}$. Base 100 cut gaya, naya ratio $16:30:50$ yaani $8:15:25$ aagaya. A aur C ka difference $25 - 8 = 17$ unit hai. Sawal kehta hai ye $25500$ hai. $1$ unit = $1500$. B ki income puchi hai ($15$ unit), toh $15 \times 1500 = 22500$ answer hoga! Bawal cheez hai ye ratio base shifting. Method 2 (Concept Builder): A ki income ka $25\% = 4x \implies A = 16x$. B ki income ka $20\% = 6x \implies B = 30x$. C ki income ka $10\% = 5x \implies C = 50x$. Income ratio $16x : 30x : 50x = 8 : 15 : 25$. Diff $25 - 8 = 17$ unit $= 25500$. $1$ unit $= 1500$. $B = 15 \times 1500 = 22500$. Exam Takeaway: Expenditure diya ho aur saving ratio pooche to turant $100 - x$ karke equate kar liya kar.

B$6 / 20\% = 30$

questions_hin.q_hi: Identical protein powder scoops are sold in jars of two sizes, small and large. The large jar is sold for twice the price of the small jar. If the selling price per gram of protein in the large jar is $12 \%$ less than that in the small jar, then the percentage by which the weight of protein in the large jar exceeds that in the small jar is nearest to:
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: Cross-Product

Pen-Free Observation: Price double hua aur rate $12 \%$ kam yani $100$ se $88$. Seedha fractional ratio lagao bina kisi 100 ya x ke. Weight ka ratio $Price/Rate$ hota hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique): Fractional ratios se comparison karo. Values likho aur cross divide karo.

Mathematically :-

questions_hin.q_hi: Two saleswomen, Kavitha and Kalyani, are allowed 12\% and 15\% commission, respectively on the total sales made by them. Kavitha gets 3\% and Kalyani gets 5\% extra bonus on the sales over Rs. 20,000. If the difference in total earning of both Kavitha and Kalyani is Rs. 7,600, then Kavitha's total earning is:
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: 3. JSM (Junior Satisfaction Method) / Deviation & 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, jab sales par commission aur bonus alag-alag ho, toh base shift karke ya total sales ko ek single variable mein merge karke equation banane se mamla 10-15 seconds me sulajh jata hai.

Method 1 (Basic Split - Sales $> 20,000 = x$):
Total Sales = $20,000 + x$.
Kalyani's Total = $15\% \times 20,000 + 20\% \times x$
Kavitha's Total = $12\% \times 20,000 + 15\% \times x$
Difference = $3\% \times 20,000 + 5\% \times x = 7600 \implies 600 + 5\% x = 7600 \implies 5\% x = 7000 \implies x = 1,40,000$.
Kavitha's Earning = $12\% \times 20,000 + 15\% \times 1,40,000 = 2400 + 21000 = \mathbf{23,400}$.

Method 2 (Image 2 - The Split Method):
First 20k par Kalyani leads by $(15\% - 12\%) = 3\% \implies 600$ Rs.
Total difference 7600 hai, toh remaining diff = $7600 - 600 = 7000$ Rs.
On remaining sales ($x$), Kalyani leads by $(20\% - 15\%) = 5\%$.
$5\% = 7000 \implies 100\% = 1,40,000$ (Remaining Sales).
Kavitha's Earning = $(12\% \times 20,000) + (15\% \times 1,40,000) = \mathbf{23,400}$.

Method 3 (Image 2 - The Pro 'Shifted Base' Method):
Maan le bonus first 20k par bhi milta (Fake base)!
Kalyani gets extra $5\% \times 20,000 = +1000$.
Kavitha gets extra $3\% \times 20,000 = +600$.
Naya Difference = $7600 + 1000 - 600 = 8000$.
Ab flat percentage par difference = $20\% - 15\% = 5\%$.
$5\% = 8000 \implies \text{Total Sales} = 1,60,000$.
Kavitha's Real Earning = $(15\% \times 1,60,000) - (\text{Fake } 600) = 24000 - 600 = \mathbf{23,400}$.

Method 4 (Total Sales = $x$ / Single Merged Equation):
Total Sales = $x$. Bonus milega $(x - 20,000)$ par.
Kalyani = $15\% x + 5\%(x - 20000) = 20\% x - 1000$.
Kavitha = $12\% x + 3\%(x - 20000) = 15\% x - 600$.
Difference = $(20\% x - 1000) - (15\% x - 600) = 7600 \implies 5\% x - 400 = 7600 \implies 5\% x = 8000 \implies x = 1,60,000$.
Kavitha = $15\% \times 1,60,000 - 600 = 24000 - 600 = \mathbf{23,400}$.

Exam Takeaway: Expressions ko hamesha expand kar ke $x$ (variable) ko ek single percentage block me merge kar liya kar, ya Method 3 (Shifted base) laga ke pen-free nikal liya kar!

questions_hin.q_hi: A traveler loses $20 \frac{1}{2} \%$ of his total money and after spending $80 \%$ of the remainder, he is left with Rs. 159. How much money did he have at the start?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change

Pen-Free Observation: $20.5 \%$ toh gaya, bacha seedha $79.5 \%$. Ab us remaining ka $80 \%$ kharch ho gaya matlab bacha sirf $20 \%$. Seedha $79.5 \%$ ka $20 \%$ nikalna hai (yani $1/5$-th) jo exactly $15.9 \%$ baithta hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique): Seedha final percentage bacha kar value se compare kar.

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Remaining after loss} = 100 \% - 20.5 \% = 79.5 \% \\ \text{Left after spending } 80 \% = 20 \% \text{ of Remaining} \\ \text{Final Left} = 20 \% \text{ of } 79.5 \% = \frac{1}{5} \times 79.5 \% = 15.9 \% \\ 15.9 \% = 159 \\ 1 \% = 10 \implies 100 \% = 1000 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Fractional chain equation setup karo base P maan ke.

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Let total money} = P \\ P \times (1 - 0.205) \times (1 - 0.8) = 159 \\ P \times 0.795 \times 0.2 = 159 \\ P \times 0.159 = 159 \\ P = \frac{159}{0.159} = 1000 $$

Exam Takeaway: $20 \frac{1}{2} \%$ dekh ke hamesha mixed fraction me open karne ki need nahi padti, decimals ($20.5 \%$) kabhi kabhi exactly setup hote hain ki directly multiply ho jaye.

Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Lagatar 3 baar 55% girne se value zameen par aa jayegi. Uspe chotu sa 65% ka increment ghanta fark nahi daalega. Answer bhayankar decrease (around 85%) hi aayega. Isme ratio method calc hoga bahut zyada and ganda wala so approx leke chalo. so always prefer this method for large changes

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai, formula wagaira sab bhool ja, seedha decimals multiplier laga. 55% gira yani $0.45$ bacha.
Net multiplier = $0.45 \times 0.45 \times 0.45 \times 1.65$.
$$0.091125 \times 1.65 \approx 0.1503$$
Yani original value ka lagbhag $15.04\%$ hi bacha hai. Toh decrease kitna hua? $100 - 15.04 = 84.96\%$.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Yahan $X + Y + \frac{XY}{100}$ wala formula lagana apne pairo par kulhadi maarne jaisa hai. Chain reaction decimals me chalana hi padega.

questions_hin.q_hi: Income of a person increases by $x\%$ and $x/2\%$ during first and third year but decreases by $x\%$ and $x/2\%$ 2nd year and 4th year respectively if the total decrement during four year is $\text{Rs. } 3340.8$. then find the initial income of person if during first two-year, total salary decreases by $36\%$

Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, thoda heavy question hai, tukdo me padh! Ek baar plus, ek baar same percent minus ho, toh result humesha net decrease hota hai $\frac{x^2}{100}\%$. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Pehle do saal: $+x\%$ aur $-x\%$. Net change = $- \frac{x^2}{100}\%$. Ye value $36\%$ decrease ke barabar di hai. Toh $\frac{x^2}{100} = 36 \implies x = 60$. Teesra aur chautha saal padh: $x/2 = 30\%$ se badha aur fir $30\%$ ghata. Iska net decrease hoga $- \frac{30^2}{100} = -9\%$. Charo saal ka overall successive nikal: Pehle cycle me value $0.64$ times bachi (36% gayi), dusre me $0.91$ times (9% gayi). Overall bachi $= 0.64 \times 0.91 = 0.5824$. Decrease kitna hua? $1 - 0.5824 = 0.4176$ (yani $41.76\%$). $41.76\%$ of Initial Salary = $3340.8$. Solve karega toh Base = $3340.8 / 0.4176 = 8000$ aayega. Method 2 (Concept Builder): Fraction se ratio banayega tab bhi aayega par 0.64 aur 0.91 ke decimals zyada clean approach dete hain yahan. questions_hin.q_hi: In an examination, the maximum possible score is N while the pass mark is $45\%$ of N. A candidate obtains 36 marks, but falls short of the pass mark by $68\%$. Which one of the following is then correct?

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Pass mark apne aap me $100\%$ benchmark hai. Agar koi $68\%$ se piche reh gaya, toh usne laya kitna? Sirf $100\% - 68\% = 32\%$ of passing marks! Ab $32\% = 36$ marks hai. Toh passing marks hue $\frac{36}{32} \times 100 = 112.5$. Question keh raha hai Pass marks N ka $45\%$ hai. Toh $0.45N = 112.5 \implies N = \frac{11250}{45} = 250$. Ab option check kar, 250 kahan fit hota hai? Option D ($243 < N < 252$) me perfectly lie karta hai! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Lamba likhna hai toh likh: Pass = $P$. Score = $P - 0.68P = 0.32P$. Given $0.32P = 36 \implies P = 112.5$. Fir $P = 0.45N \implies 112.5 = 0.45N \implies N = 250$. Concept wahi hai bas variable badle hain. questions_hin.q_hi: The value of a crypto portfolio increases by $37.5\%$ in week 1, then drops by 21,000 dollars in week 2, and again surges by $14 \frac{2}{7}\%$ in week 3. If the final value is exactly $50\%$ more than the initial invested amount, find the initial investment.
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling & Reverse Gear.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, yahan percentages hain $37.5\%$ (yaani $3/8$), $14 \frac{2}{7}\%$ (yaani $1/7$) aur $50\%$ (yaani $1/2$). Seedha denominators 8 aur 7 ka LCM 56 pakad aur isko apna base unit man le. Ek absolute drop (21,000 dollars) diya hai, bas usi gap ko units me pakadna hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique): Unitary Reverse Gear.

Mathematically :-

$$Initial = 56u \\ Final = 56u + 50\% = 84u \\ W1_{end} (Forward) = 56u \times \frac{11}{8} = 77u \\ W2_{end} (Backward) = 84u \times \frac{7}{8} = 73.5u \\ Gap (Drop) = 77u - 73.5u = 3.5u \\ 3.5u = 21000 \\ 1u = 6000 \\ Initial (56u) = 56 \times 6000 = 336000$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Variable Reverse Gear.

Mathematically :-

$$Initial = P \\ Final = \frac{3P}{2} \\ W1_{end} = P \times \frac{11}{8} = \frac{11P}{8} \\ W2_{end} (Reverse \ from \ Final) = \frac{3P}{2} \times \frac{7}{8} = \frac{21P}{16} \\ W1_{end} - W2_{end} = 21000 \\ \frac{11P}{8} - \frac{21P}{16} = 21000 \\ \frac{22P - 21P}{16} = 21000 \\ \frac{P}{16} = 21000 \\ P = 336000$$

Exam Takeaway: Jab bhi chain percentage me ek absolute number intermediate step me aa jaye, LCM unit man kar aage aur piche dono taraf se attack kar. Jo gap aayega wahi tera absolute number hoga. Calculation error ka chance zero!

questions_hin.q_hi: In an examination, A got 25% marks more than B, B got 10% less than C and C got 25% more than D. If D got 320 marks out of 500, then the marks obtained by A were?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, jab bhi sequential ya chain mein percentage change ho (A se B, B se C, C se D), toh beech ke variables alag se nikalne ki zaroorat nahi hai. Sidha unka fraction ratio likh kar multiply maar de, B aur C apne aap cancel out ho jayenge aur direct First (A) aur Last (D) ka ratio bachega. Image me jo tune kiya hai, wahi exact ninja technique hai!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Ratio method lagakar sidha multiply kar de (teri image wali method). Mathematically :-

$$ \frac{A}{B} \times \frac{B}{C} \times \frac{C}{D} = \frac{A}{D} $$

$$ \frac{5}{4} \times \frac{9}{10} \times \frac{5}{4} = \frac{45}{32} $$

$$ \text{Here, } \frac{A}{D} = \frac{45}{32} $$

$$ 32 \text{ units } \rightarrow 320 $$

$$ 45 \text{ units } \rightarrow 450 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Peechhe se pakad aur individually backward chain solve kar (jab intermediate values nikalni pad jayein). Mathematically :-

$$ C = 320 + (320 \times \frac{1}{4}) = 400 $$

$$ B = 400 - (400 \times \frac{1}{10}) = 360 $$

$$ A = 360 + (360 \times \frac{1}{4}) = 450 $$

Exam Takeaway: Chain questions mein agar bas First (A) aur Last (D) ka aapas mein relation nikalna ho, toh unke Multiplier Fractions ko direct aapas mein multiply karna sabse fast approach hota hai.

questions_hin.q_hi: A fruit seller sells $45\%$ of the oranges that he has along with one more orange to a customer. He then sells $20\%$ of the remaining oranges and 2 more oranges to a second customer. He then sells $90\%$ of the now remaining oranges to a third customer and is still left with 5 oranges. How many oranges did the fruit seller have initially?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, jab bhi successive remainder wala sawal ho aur numbers me kuch extra joda/ghataya jaye, wahan aage se equations banana suicide hai. Hamesha Reverse Line Method (Peeche se aage ki taraf) use kar. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): C3 (Customer 3) ko $90\%$ becha aur fir bhi 5 bache hain. Yani jo $10\%$ bacha uski value 5 hai. Toh C3 ke aane se theek pehle total $50$ oranges the. C2 ke time: usne $20\%$ beche aur 2 extra diye. Agar wo 2 extra nahi diye hote, toh uske paas $50+2=52$ hote. Ye 52, us stage ka $80\%$ bacha hua hissa tha. Toh C2 ke aane se pehle total = $\frac{52}{0.8} = 65$ the. C1 ke time: usne $45\%$ beche aur 1 extra diya. Agar 1 extra nahi diya hota, toh $65+1=66$ bachte, jo initial ka $55\%$ hote (kyunki $45\%$ bik gaya tha). Toh Initial Total = $\frac{66}{0.55} = 120$. Piche se socho, mind me ho jayega. Method 2 (Concept Builder): Options se uthakar forward track kar sakte ho agar reverse samajh nahi aa raha, jaise 120 ka 45% + 1 nikalna, fir jo bache uspe game khelna. Exam Takeaway: Remaining items aur constant adjustments wale sawal hamesha reverse engineering mangte hain.
